nickname.description: An identifiable nickname or alias for the PostgreSQL server.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

port.description: The port number on which the PostgreSQL server is listening.

database.description: The name of the default database to connect to.

username.description: The username to authenticate with when connecting to the PostgreSQL server.
